receipt.public_excerpt: Although GPT-4o demonstrates remarkable capabilities in generating complex scenes, it still faces significant challenges in producing coherent multi-person scenarios and object-human interactions.

evidence_items.explanation: ChatGPT's 2025 image generator is often good, but it still fails on object-human interactions, the kind of scene in the post. Its outputs are therefore sometimes right and sometimes wrong.

receipt.public_excerpt: Considering text prompts, not all random noises are effective in synthesizing semantically-faithful images.

evidence_items.explanation: Says directly that, for a given prompt, some random starting points give faithful images and others do not. It predates the target period, so it is context only.

unresolved_gaps: No study found that measured repeated runs of ChatGPT-5 or Grok on the exact unicycle prompt.

The 2025 noise-search study shows that automated checkers can pick out better samples, so the run-to-run variation can be screened after the fact. An ordinary user making a single request still cannot know the result in advance.
